claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Buphenine is a beta-adrenergic agonist with no reported cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative effect likely reflecting non-specific beta-agonist/vasodilator signaling rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
